report:
## Conclusion

The claim that influenza vaccination causes Alzheimer's disease is **not supported by evidence** — and if anything, the balance of research points the opposite direction: flu vaccination is associated with a *reduced*, not increased, risk of Alzheimer's disease and dementia.

Multiple observational studies converge on this finding. A large claims-based cohort study using propensity-score matching in older US adults (Bukhbinder et al., 2022) found flu vaccination was associated with roughly a 40% lower relative risk of developing Alzheimer's disease over four years (journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.3233/JAD-220361). Related analyses summarized by UTHealth Houston found similar protective associations for flu, pneumococcal, shingles, and Tdap vaccines (uth.edu). Independent cohorts—including heart-failure patients and veterans—have reported comparable reduced dementia risk with flu vaccination, and newer target-trial-emulation work on high-dose flu vaccine also found lower Alzheimer's risk (sfchronicle.com). A recent New York Times summary of this literature (2025) likewise reports vaccination trends toward protection, not harm (nytimes.com).

A recent widely circulated claim (via a Substack blog, "thefocalpoints.com") asserting vaccines "cause" a 38–50% increased dementia risk has been fact-checked and found not to support causation; it misrepresents an observational dataset with substantial confounding (e.g., "healthy vaccinee bias") and does not overturn the peer-reviewed literature (meddmo.eu).

All of this evidence is observational/associational, not proof of a protective *mechanism*, and cannot establish definitive causation in either direction. But no credible peer-reviewed evidence supports flu vaccination causing Alzheimer's disease; existing data suggest a protective association instead.

**Sources:**

- https://www.uth.edu/news/story/several-vaccines-associated-with-reduced-risk-of-alzheimers-disease-in-adults-65-and-older
- https://meddmo.eu/study-does-not-prove-vaccines-increase-dementia-risk/
- https://www.nytimes.com/2025/06/14/health/elderly-vaccines-dementia.html
